component.name: Music
component.summary: A simple and modern music player for Linux

description.p: Music is a native Linux music player built with C, GTK4, Libadwaita, and GStreamer. Its clean and modern interface provides a simple way to enjoy your local music collection.

Browse music from a selected directory or open individual audio files independently. Manage your playlist, organize tracks, and control playback with an interface designed for the GNOME desktop environment.

ul.li: Browse and play music from selected directories
Open and play individual audio files
Skip to the previous or next track
Manage playlists by removing tracks or clearing the list
Sort tracks alphabetically or by modification date
Remember the last selected music directory
Integrate with desktop media controls through MPRIS
